atomic_cutover: Switch the only caller and remove the old provider in one deploy.
tests: Facade contract, RLS, rollback, and repository-failure tests.

runtime_evidence.source: Synthetic example only; replace with observed cutover evidence.
runtime_evidence.workload: Synthetic example: 30 sequential calls after five warmups on an isolated PostgreSQL 17 database.
runtime_evidence.thresholds: Synthetic example: at most two statements per call and no unexpected errors.

affected_rows.result: Synthetic example: one row inserted per successful call; zero committed after injected rollback.

query_count.result: Synthetic example: two statements per successful call across 30 samples.

latency_p50.result: Synthetic example: p50 2 ms across 30 samples.

latency_p95.result: Synthetic example: p95 4 ms across 30 samples.

errors.result: Synthetic example: zero unexpected errors in 30 calls.

pool_wait.result: Synthetic example: sql.DBStats wait count and duration stayed zero.

lock_wait.result: Synthetic example: no Lock wait events in 10 ms PostgreSQL samples; polling can miss shorter waits.

deadlocks.result: Synthetic example: database deadlock counter unchanged; no serialization retries.

job_duration.reason: Synthetic example: the migrated capability has no worker path.

job_retries.reason: Synthetic example: the migrated capability has no worker path.

job_backlog.reason: Synthetic example: the migrated capability has no worker path.

failure.result: Synthetic example: injected owner failure returned the expected stable error.

rollback.result: Synthetic example: injected failure left the before/after database snapshots identical.

smoke.result: Synthetic example: production router integration test passed for the affected route.

rollback_and_cleanup: Revert caller wiring; remove the old adapter after the observation window.
exit_criterion: All callers use one provider and the listed ratchet keys are absent.
